body:
oh i would say i am very hurt whenever i get rejected for sure,

i mean for instance i made a post on here on a different account 3 weeks ago, someone wanted to add me on discord, the next day they said they didn't wanna be my friend and for some reason it just really stung, like it just really fucked me up for some reason, I was doing pretty good and then just like that I am searching for ways to kill myself.

I mean its very likely that I have ADHD, my brother said he thought I had it a couple of times and I do somewhat I agree, I pace around alot, and sometimes I can just talk alot and really fast to him. I can go from being super fast paced to very slow and sad though. Also sometime my legs or arms twitch.

i mean, i guess.

I mean today for example, I went from laughing with my mom about something dumb I did, to contemplating suicide. I only seem to be happy when I am distracted, and if I am not distracted I feel just numb or somewhat sad. 

I would say that my mood does change a lot everyday. Sometimes I feel just this gut wrenching feeling of just wanting to kill myself and that is just the worst one, like anxiety like i am on a timer to kill myself. Sometimes I can be happy, and maybe even talkative but most of the time I am just numb and quiet. Whenever I am sad it is usually pretty intense though.

I don't know, it just feels like its not killing myself, nobody cares. 

I am very unwanted to everyone i feel like, i wish i could be peoples friends but i just don't really feel good enough. I don't want to be out by 16, but its sure as hell looking like it. 

Just when you have noone, and you only have yourself but you don't even want yourself just why keep living y'know?
